title: Lina (wallet holder)
description: Persona: a 34-year-old teacher who keeps her health records in a personal health wallet on her phone and travels for work. Fictional.

persona.name: Lina
persona.goal: Share her health information only with the people who need it, for as long as they need it.
needs: To see who can read her record, and to withdraw that at any time
One link that works abroad as well as at home
To know when her record was read, and by whom
frustrations: Consent forms she cannot read back later
Not knowing whether a withdrawal took effect
